tagline: Sync meeting invites with HubSpot contacts and log calls to your CRM automatically
metaTitle: Google Calendar + HubSpot Integration: Meetings in HubSpot
metaDescription: Walk into sales meetings with context. GAIA adds HubSpot contact data to calendar invites and logs each finished meeting. See the setup steps.
intro:
Sales and customer success teams live between two critical tools: Google Calendar for scheduling client meetings and HubSpot for managing the CRM records of those same clients. The problem is that the two rarely talk to each other. Meetings happen on the calendar but are manually logged in the CRM — or worse, never logged at all. Contact details aren't visible in calendar invites. The result is a CRM that is perpetually behind and a team that wastes time on manual data entry.

GAIA bridges Google Calendar and HubSpot so that client meetings are automatically enriched with CRM data and automatically logged as activities. When you schedule a meeting with a known contact, GAIA adds their company, deal stage, and recent activity to the event description so you're prepared. When the meeting ends, GAIA logs it with attendees, duration, and any notes you add, keeping your CRM accurate without any manual entry.

This integration is essential for sales reps, account executives, and customer success managers who need their meeting and CRM records to stay in perfect alignment without the overhead of double data entry.

useCases.title: Enrich calendar invites with HubSpot contact data
useCases.description: When you schedule an event with a contact's email address, GAIA automatically adds their company, title, deal stage, and last interaction date to the event description so you walk into every meeting prepared.

useCases.title: Auto-log completed meetings to the CRM
useCases.description: When an event with a known contact ends, GAIA logs it as a meeting activity with attendees, duration, and the event description, keeping your CRM up to date without manual logging.

useCases.title: Create follow-up tasks from calendar events
useCases.description: After a meeting is logged, GAIA automatically creates a follow-up task for the rep with a suggested due date so the next step is always captured and the deal keeps moving forward.

useCases.title: Surface deal context before meetings
useCases.description: The day before a client meeting, GAIA sends you a briefing with the deal status, recent email activity, open tasks, and any notes from previous meetings so you're fully prepared without opening the CRM.

useCases.title: Sync HubSpot meeting links to calendar invites
useCases.description: When HubSpot Meetings is used to schedule calls, GAIA syncs those bookings to Google Calendar with full event details, ensuring your personal calendar reflects every client-scheduled meeting automatically.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and HubSpot to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize your calendar and HubSpot portal in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA matches calendar attendees to contacts by email address to enrich and log events accurately.

howItWorks.step: Configure enrichment, logging, and follow-up rules
howItWorks.description: Set which contact and deal fields should appear in calendar event descriptions, which completed event types should be auto-logged to the CRM, and whether follow-up tasks should be created automatically.

howItWorks.step: GAIA enriches meetings and logs them automatically
howItWorks.description: Before each meeting GAIA enriches the calendar event with CRM context. After the meeting ends, GAIA logs the activity and creates follow-up tasks, completing the full sales activity loop.

faqs.question: What if a meeting attendee is not in HubSpot?
faqs.answer: GAIA can automatically create a new contact when a meeting is logged with an attendee email that doesn't match an existing contact, or it can flag the attendee for manual review depending on your preference.

faqs.question: Can GAIA log internal meetings or only client-facing ones?
faqs.answer: You can configure GAIA to log all meetings, only meetings with external attendees, or only meetings where attendees match known contacts. This keeps your activity log focused on customer interactions.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support deal associations when logging meetings?
faqs.answer: Yes. When logging a meeting, GAIA associates the activity with the deal or deals linked to the attendee contacts, so the meeting appears in the deal timeline and not just the contact record.
